conditional_decisions.decision: Self-contained same-frame mirrors replaces inter-request patch; bounded admission replaces unproven pool. This is documented scope decision, not claiming patch/pool exists.
Identity-keyed readonly useMemo is a valid semantic-key cache; no reason to retain stale previews across world versions or add pure plan/executor absent measured bottleneck.
Legacy removal conditioned on consumer evidence; absence of deletion is intentional. V2 export/transfer remains a separate local prerequisite.
Exact lossless WebP is accepted alternative to lossy/resized/AVIF; generic map print source-switch not an explicit original requirement.
